# Higgsfield Product Photoshoot

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — a product-photography skill for the Higgsfield CLI: before generating, the agent runs a short labeled-option interview (product photo, use case, style, placement), then submits one command — `higgsfield product-photoshoot create --mode <mode>` — and a backend prompt enhancer assembles the final prompt for GPT Image 2. Ten modes cover the full commerce arc: product_shot, lifestyle_scene, closeup with person, moodboard_pin, hero_banner, social_carousel, ad_creative_pack, virtual_model_tryout, conceptual_product, and restyle of an existing image. By @higgsfield-ai, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: generation runs on the Higgsfield backend — requires a Higgsfield account (`higgsfield auth login`) and generations are billed through their service; fidelity is best with an uploaded product photo, text-only prompts work but are weaker; the install step runs a piped `curl | sh` install script — inspect it before running. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
